environment_management.title: Environments are a production feature
environment_management.body:
An environment is a complete, separately governed copy of your model — sources, tables, policies, masking rules and grants. Teams keep a dev environment to change the model in, a staging one to review it in, and prod to serve from, then move the change forward by merging one environment into the next with a diff, an approval and an undoable history.

Your sandbox IS one of these environments, minted for you alone. Managing them — creating, merging, deploying, retiring — belongs to the organization that owns them, so the surface is shown here rather than handed over: you can see what it does, and it acts on nothing.
